title: Profitable email signal engine conformance correction
purpose: Re-run the HY-EXP-0037 signal-engine specification after correcting implementation-conformance defects. This is a specification-conformance correction, not post-loss strategy tuning.

priorExperiment.sourceOutcome: NO_PROFITABLE_EMAIL_STRATEGY_FOUND is not a valid strategy conclusion because HY-EXP-0037 violated the frozen implementation contract.

conformanceRule: HY-EXP-0038 may correct only the material implementation deviations from the original HY-EXP-0037 specification. It may not change stop, target, cost, signal-frequency target, validation gates, feature family, universe, holding horizon, entry/exit semantics, or any economic parameter based on HY-EXP-0037 outcomes.

historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0028: Historical negative/reference evidence only; never an independent validation set.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0030: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no strategy or outcome tuning.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0032: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no family, parameter, symbol, or outcome selection.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0033: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no recovered-data tournament result is reused for selection.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0034: Only its hash-locked public source manifest is reused as a raw-data provenance reference; its outcomes are not reused.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0037: Invalid implementation result; no outcome or metric is used to tune this correction.
historicalReferences.HY-DATA-0036: Forward microstructure collection remains paused and is not required for this historical signal-only objective.

primarySources: Binance official public USD-M historical archive: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um
Existing HY-EXP-0034 hash-locked native public source files for the same window
dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Any missing, duplicate, non-contiguous, non-finite, out-of-window, hash-mismatched, non-causal, or unproven row rejects the affected source and prevents a PASS. No silent repair.

universe.eligibility: Only the eight fixed symbols with complete causal required streams in the hash-locked source manifest. No later symbol list may add, remove, or rescue a symbol.

candidateGenerator.name: BROAD_BIDIRECTIONAL_15M_CAUSAL_CANDIDATES
candidateGenerator.decision: Every completed 15m decision for every fixed symbol emits both an independent BUY candidate and an independent SELL candidate when all frozen feature inputs are complete.
candidateGenerator.regime: BULL, BEAR, or SIDEWAYS is causal context/feature only; it is never a raw-candidate gate.
candidateGenerator.sidewaysAction: SIDEWAYS is retained as context and cannot suppress either raw candidate.
candidateGenerator.buyRegime: BULL context label only; not a BUY candidate gate.
candidateGenerator.sellRegime: BEAR context label only; not a SELL candidate gate.
candidateGenerator.requiredInvariant: For every complete symbol plus decisionTime, raw BUY count equals one and raw SELL count equals one, including BULL, BEAR, and SIDEWAYS contexts.

referenceTrade.entry: first exact contract-price 5m OPEN at or after the decision boundary; no later rescue entry
referenceTrade.atr: ATR20 from completed 1h contract-price bars available no later than decisionTime
referenceTrade.terminalRule: When bar.openTime equals entryTime plus 12 hours, execute MAX_HOLD at that bar open before reading that bar high or low; then terminate the reference trade.
referenceTrade.overlap: Same-symbol cooldown equals the active reference trade interval; no pyramiding or reversal. Early actual stop/target exit releases the symbol for a later decision.
referenceTrade.funding: Every realized funding event strictly within the held interval is applied separately using actual side and mark price.

costs.charge: One frozen all-in execution cost budget per entry and exit fill; source-embedded costs are not charged twice.

features.availability: Every feature is frozen at decisionTime or earlier; missing, late, non-finite, or non-PIT input invalidates the candidate.
features.fundingRule: Only realized funding events with event time less than or equal to decisionTime are eligible; no future funding is used.

model.name: RIDGE_EXPECTED_RETURN_MODEL
model.targetWinsorization: Within every training fold, clip raw training net27Bps target at the training-only P01 and P99. Validation, OOF, and historical outcome metrics always use raw unwinsorized outcomes.
model.trainingOnlyScaling: Feature mean/std are fitted on the training fold only; no additional validation-feature clipping.
model.oofProtocol: For each lambda independently, run every Development walk-forward fold and retain a complete independent OOF prediction set. Never mix OOF predictions produced by different lambdas.
model.selection: Select jointly over lambda and deterministic predicted-edge threshold configurations from independent OOF sets only; Historical Validation cannot select lambda or threshold.
model.negativeThresholdDiagnostic: If the frozen selectedMinimumEdgeBps is less than or equal to zero, report NEGATIVE_MODEL_EDGE_THRESHOLD=true; it is diagnostic only and is not an added promotion gate.

walkForward.method: Expanding purged walk-forward with OOF-only selection
walkForward.historicalValidationRetrain: Rolling monthly causal retrain using only the trailing prior 365 days; a month outcome is never used before the next month.

frequency.sameDecisionSymbolSide: Predict BUY and SELL separately. If both meet the threshold, keep only the higher predicted edge with an exact deterministic tie-break.
frequency.crossSymbolRanking: Rank eligible candidates by predicted edge at the decision boundary.

developmentSelection.search: lambda x deterministic predicted-edge threshold grid only
developmentSelection.thresholdGrid: OOF predicted-edge empirical percentiles 90.0 through 99.9 on a fixed deterministic grid, computed within Development only for each lambda-specific OOF set.

emailPreparation.gating: EMAIL_PREPARED=true and EMAIL_ACTIVATED=false only after all historical hard gates pass
